preservation_units.meaning: Having to prove masculinity makes the role fake and forces repeated defense of the identity whenever Joel hesitates, cries, needs help or is wrong.
Joel cries, needs help and gets things wrong; Bee called him her wife; the joke remains.
A woman's appreciation of Joel's masculine side tends to draw it out by itself.
A woman should not have to perform femininity; surrender has more meaning when she retains agency and chooses it; Joel finds that erotic.
Fear of being undesirable/emotional/difficult/illogical/needy can overcorrect into needing nobody and experiencing care or male leadership as weakness.
Toft still tells his aging wife she is beautiful; Anami emphasizes receiving; a strong woman is not helpless for receiving help/leadership/pleasure, and a man is not a child for receiving care.
A capable woman may ask Joel to drive for the experience; Joel may request her intuitive view and she may request his practical thinking; these are chosen reciprocal roles.
Polarity/leadership should be invitational rather than forced, expressed with party invitation vs war draft analogy.
A woman who cannot gently invite a man to lead may manufacture a crisis until he must take charge; Joel has seen this often.
